LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMurmurQuest.questDescriptionR: questDescription->After the colony has endured enough days and deaths, something beyond the threshold has finally pried open a seam. A being entangled with life, corpses, and karma sends you a single message through that rift.\n\nIf you are willing to listen, a temporary site named "Hideout of the Nonexistent" will appear near your settlement. Zhaoli waits there for an exchange, a delayed answer, or a refusal that tears the matter apart completely.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliReturnQuest.questDescriptionR: questDescription->Zhaoli has made her answer. Whether it first came through herbal medicine, a corpse, or a slaughter between you and her, it has followed the same thread back here.\n\nIf you accept her, Zhaoli will formally join the colony after today.
